verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents versioning Gumloop agents or workflows in source control, or separate dev and production environments with a promotion path. The nearby items cover other things: GitHub sync for Organization Skills, GitHub-push deploys for Hosted MCP server code, version tracking of agent-generated artifacts, and API create/update of agents. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not workflow versioning and promotion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
